column1: # What real Denote produces, for every component.
# Not written by hand. Regenerate with Emacs and denote.el on `load-path`:
# Measured with GNU Emacs 30.2 and denote.el 4.1.0 on 2026-08-26. Four
# tab-separated fields: what a person typed, then Denote's title, signature and
# keyword slugs. A blank slug is written as the empty field between two tabs.
# `crates/nc-ids/tests/against_denote.rs` runs every row. Three rows are expected to differ and
# say so there, each because a name has to survive a filesystem Denote does not
# consider: this repository removes `<`, `>`, `\` and the C0 controls (U+0000
# to U+001F, and nothing adjacent — Windows permits U+007F and C1, and Denote
写真 の アルバム
